chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Giyas ibn Ibrahim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
My father used to lengthen the soles of his sandals.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Baqir do with his sandals according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This brief narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the practical modesty of Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him), whose lengthened sandal straps (thawabib) were a distinctive feature of his attire. In Shia jurisprudence, this serves as a foundational precedent for the permissibility and recommended etiquette of wearing sandals with long straps, reflecting the Ahl al-Bayt's adherence to both utility and dignified appearance.
